title: SAMPLE - Autonomous Agricultural Drone
description: An intelligent drone platform designed for precision agriculture and crop health monitoring. It automates targeted pesticide spraying and multispectral vegetation analysis across rural farms.

title: SAMPLE - Smart Water Quality Monitor
description: An IoT-enabled sensor array deployed to analyze dissolved oxygen and pollutant levels in real time. Continuous telemetry is uploaded to a cloud dashboard for environmental alerts.

title: SAMPLE - Solar Powered E-Vehicle
description: A lightweight electric quadricycle featuring integrated rooftop solar panels and regenerative braking. Engineered entirely by student innovators to enable zero-emission campus commuting.

title: SAMPLE - VSLV Rocket Propulsion Unit
description: A solid rocket motor testbed engineered for high-altitude student atmospheric research missions. It incorporates custom telemetry avionics and redundant parachute deployment systems.

title: SAMPLE - Bionic Prosthetic Arm
description: A low-cost 3D-printed prosthetic limb controlled by surface electromyography muscle sensors. Designed to restore functional motor grip movements for amputees at accessible costs.

title: SAMPLE - Low-Cost Mechanical Ventilator
description: An automated emergency ventilator developed for primary healthcare centres lacking ICU infrastructure. Features motorized bag-valve compression with pressure relief safety valves.
